name: shader-smoke-ring
title: Smoke Ring
description: A single soft ring of smoke curls and dissipates in the center of a dark field, drawn in WebGL.
useWhen: You want a single soft, centered smoke ring as a focal atmospheric element.
A minimal, premium scene benefits from one curling shape on a dark field.
You want a neutral, near-monochrome look (override `colors` to tint).
avoidWhen: You need a full-bleed edge-to-edge texture: this is a centered object; use a noise or gradient shader.
The center sits behind key text: the ring draws the eye inward.
You want multiple elements or busy motion: smoke-ring is deliberately singular.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: How fast it moves. 0 holds still.

variables.label: Colors
variables.description: Up to 10 colors, comma separated, the smoke moves through.

variables.label: Inner shape
variables.description: How the inside of the ring fades.

variables.label: Noise detail
variables.description: Layers of smoke detail; lower renders faster.

variables.label: Scale
variables.description: Zooms the shader in or out.

variables.label: Resolution
variables.description: Share of the frame size the shader is drawn at, then scaled up. Lower renders faster; raise it when fine detail looks soft.
